intermediate.candidate_rule: Replay exactly the 25 and 35 surviving proposals and require every regenerated SAM mask hash to match the frozen intermediate.

evaluation.truth_timing: Rank only by the reference-decoupled local patch score; read IoU afterward.

mechanism.closed_dependency: The predecessor chose one reference using final-layer global memory and then computed local patch evidence only against that reference.
mechanism.new_decision: Compute query-to-template layer-19 foreground patch coverage independently for every reference and let the patch channel choose its own winning reference.
mechanism.score: For each query patch, take its maximum cosine over one reference patch set and average; then take the maximum score across references.
mechanism.candidate_output: The three highest-scoring original proposals, without score fusion, axis completion, scale penalty, or truth use.
mechanism.independence_boundary: This removes a decision dependency but is not an independent sensor or confirmation source because both channels still use DINOv2 and SAM2.

gate.requirements: Both reachable correct proposals must enter the top three, at least one query must improve over the conditional-reference patch rank, and neither may regress.

next_action: Freeze and run this exact patch-reference decision on the next unopened source-queue family before any RGB/model access; do not retune on ARV.
fallback_action: Close reference decoupling as insufficient and move to a new information source with active query geometry; do not add patch-score weights or ARV-specific rules.
claim_boundary: ARV is a consumed Development family. This experiment isolates candidate referent ranking only; it is not independent confirmation and says nothing about portal ownership, access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or safety.
